correctness.rationale: Classifies all self-inverse partial star isometries in two leaf-involution branches and exactly m hub–leaf edge swaps. The finite polynomial follows by disjoint counting. Conditioning independent Poisson singleton and pair counts on total m yields the omitted-leaf law, and a lattice local CLT with suppressed parity arc gives total variation to Poisson(sqrt(m+1)-1), then convolution with a fair hub bit. Exact direct enumeration confirmed all cases m=2..6; finite computation is not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural whole-family rank statistic of involutive partial star symmetries acquires a precise total-variation limit that distinguishes independent hub exclusion from a growing Poisson number of omitted leaves, and identifies exactly the rare nonextendible involutions. This goes beyond a monoid-cardinality special case and supports quantitative sampling across dimensions.
